{{Quote|If it weren't for these ''brave Rebels'' doing ''whatever it takes'' to fight the ''Empire''&hellip; you would have lost much ''more'' than your monument.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to the citizens of [[Tandankin]]|<ref name="Special" />}}
The '''Tandankin monument''' was a tall tower respected by the [[Tandankin]] citizenry as their greatest monument. [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], unaware of its status, shot it down during the [[Battle of Tandankin|mission on Tandankin]] in order to destroy a line of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] parked near it. The people of Tandankin were furious with Antilles until [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] gave a speech reminding them of Antilles's accomplishments and good intentions, and stating that the monument was a small price to pay for freedom from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
